ticket.subject: Emails stopped going out
ticket.body_text:
Hey team,

Writing on behalf of Glimmerbrook BV. No notification emails have gone out from any of our workspaces since 15:35 UTC, so our customers are not getting their receipts.

The email log in the admin area is empty for today.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. Please treat this as an incident.

Thanks so much!
Kenji Okonkwo
